result.brief: 提出意图优先的潜在规划范式：目标条件 JEPA 生成潜在意图，动作条件 JEPA 在共享潜空间预测未来状态，形成意图-动作-后果闭环，用于视觉导航。
result.reason: JEPA latent world model with goal-conditioned intention proposals and action-conditioned latent prediction in shared space; visual navigation application, but representation/planning contribution is central.
